name: Nick's Night Out!
source:
The championship semifinals are intense, the audience is wild, and the police might even raid the match – but Nick has only one goal: to win and get home safely before his parents find out he skipped studying.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.apexchimps.nicksnight&hl=cs&pli=1]Google Play[/url]]
